about: Kolkata-based integrated IT and digital infrastructure solutions provider with over 19 years of experience. It designs, supplies, installs and maintains networks (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi), audio-visual, surveillance and fibre optic systems, mainly for government departments and PSUs in eastern India. It is empanelled with BSNL and RailTel and recently added data centre, AI lab and cybersecurity offerings.

promoters.background: Vineet Kumar Gupta (Chairman and MD, 69.81% pre-issue) has been with the company since incorporation and has over two decades of enterprise technology experience; he is the selling shareholder in the OFS. Juli Gupta holds 30.19%.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 94.19% of FY26 revenue (89.08% FY25, 91.87% FY24); top 1 customer 25.21% in FY26 (60.93% FY25). Government share of revenue 73.10% in FY26 (95.01% FY25). Bihar, Odisha and West Bengal gave 80.04% of FY26 revenue.

litigation_note: One direct/indirect tax proceeding of Rs 19.34 lakh against the company; Rs 65.54 lakh material civil claim filed by the company; no material civil litigation or criminal proceedings against the company or promoters. Past delays in TDS, ESIC, EPF and RoC filings were cured with fees.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 34.10 crore in FY24 to Rs 60.53 crore in FY26, a CAGR of 33.24%, with PAT rising from Rs 1.48 crore to Rs 10.22 crore.
Empanelled with BSNL (national system integrator) and RailTel, giving access to central government and PSU projects beyond individual tenders.
Over 19 years of experience delivering end-to-end networking, surveillance, AV and fibre optic projects under one roof.
Low leverage: debt-equity of 0.10 times in FY26 and borrowings of only Rs 2.71 crore.
Reported ROCE of 47.74% and RoE of 47.65% in FY26, with EBITDA margin of 21.97%.
Expanding into data centre, AI labs and cybersecurity, plus recurring AMC and fibre optic revenue (about 16.6% of FY26 revenue).
ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and registered as an IP-I telecom infrastructure provider.

risks.title: Extreme customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers made up 94.19% of FY26 revenue (89.08% FY25, 91.87% FY24); the top 3 gave 61.47% in FY26. Losing one client would hurt sharply.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on government tenders
risks.detail: Government and PSU customers gave 73.10% of FY26 revenue (95.01% in FY25). Contracts are won by competitive low-bid tenders and are exposed to budget cuts and payment delays.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow and stretched receivables
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was -Rs 6.77 crore in FY26 despite Rs 10.22 crore profit. Trade receivables rose to Rs 54.98 crore (about 91% of revenue); non-government receivables jumped to Rs 20.27 crore.

risks.title: Geographic concentration
risks.detail: Bihar, Odisha and West Bengal produced 80.04% of FY26 revenue (85.39% FY25, 64.00% FY24).

risks.title: Related party dealings and promoter loans
risks.detail: Related party transactions were 11.23% of FY26 revenue (7.54% FY25, 17.85% FY24). Promoter unsecured loans of Rs 1.38 crore are repayable on demand. Two group companies run similar business.

risks.title: Limited use of IPO money and promoter exit
risks.detail: Up to Rs 30 crore of fresh proceeds goes to working capital, with no monitoring agency. The promoter sells 4,58,000 shares via OFS. Promoters' average cost is Rs 0.08 and Rs 0.20 per share.

risks.title: Small order book and few suppliers
risks.detail: Order book was about Rs 12.18 crore at Sep 15, 2026 versus Rs 60.53 crore FY26 revenue. Top 10 suppliers were 59.60% of purchases, with no long-term contracts.

risks.title: Regulatory delays and thin governance track record
risks.detail: Past delays in TDS, ESIC, EPF and RoC filings drew penalties; most directors have no listed-company board experience; the logo trademark application is objected.

notes: Restated standalone FY24-FY26, source in Rs lakh converted to crore. Price band, issue size in Rs and P/E are blank in the RHP. Net worth, EBITDA (1,405.83 lakh), EPS, ROCE and RoE are as reported by the company; EBITDA is PBT plus interest, depreciation. FY24 PAT is 148.02 lakh. Peer revenue_cr is total income. Reservation percentages are shares as a percent of the 36,64,800-share net offer (anchor counted within QIB); a 1,93,200-share market maker portion is outside it. Current ratio not reported. Order book as of 15 Sep 2026; company notes about Rs 2 crore of quarterly fibre optic revenue is not in the order book.
